propositions: Clients using rebar CLI without a repo checkout cannot resolve internal cross-references in packaged guides because they use consumer-relative paths like `review-policy.md` and `../CONTRIBUTING.md`.
The commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT in verify_commit.py) has no discoverable CLI home and is only documented in --help output for verify-commit-ticket.

Packaged guides must repoint all dangling references to use either `rebar explain <topic>` for sibling guides or canonical hosted URLs (`https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/blob/main/...`) for repo-only docs.
A guard test must enforce that no packaged guide contains consumer-relative paths, allowing only https://, http://, intra-doc anchors, or mailto: links.
The MCP explain_criterion tool docstring must be updated to list all registered AUTHOR_GUIDES topics so that MCP clients can discover commit-trailer guide alongside plan and review.
